components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 14px; border: 0; background: var(--mp-accent, #C2381F); color: var(--mp-on-accent, #FFFFFF); font: 600 17px/22px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.93); color: var(--mp-on-accent, #FFFFFF); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--mp-focus, #2453C9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--mp-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--mp-ink, #14171F); border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 23, 31, 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(20, 23, 31, 0.06); font: 400 15px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-track { position: relative; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--mp-track, #BEC1C8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--mp-line, #E4E0DA); overflow: visible; } .ds-track-clip { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; overflow: hidden; } .ds-track-clip > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--mp-chart-line, #C2381F); border-radius: inherit; } .ds-tick { position: absolute; top: -3px; bottom: -3px; width: 2px; background: var(--mp-ink, #14171F); border-radius: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
MyPaisa DS v1 ("Warm ledger", MA-101) combines Monzo's approachable warmth — a deep navy hero account card, a crisp terracotta/coral accent, rounded hero numerals, and plain-spoken language — with Apple Human Interface Guidelines structure: Dynamic Type Large defaults (17px body), grouped inset lists, >= 44×44 targets, semantic light and dark tokens, and legibility verified even at 25% mobile screen brightness.

The system is adaptive across two native materials built on one token sheet. On iPhone and iPad, navigation bars, floating tab pills, toolbars, partial sheets, and the chat composer float in iOS 26 Liquid Glass above Warm ledger content. On the Web PWA and Android foldables, Liquid Glass and iOS sheet grabbers step aside completely for crisp Warm ledger paper chrome, hairline dividers, and keyboard-first focus rings.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone-paper ground and white ledger cards/groups anchored by a single deep navy hero card for top-level net worth or projection totals.
Dual-brightness contrast discipline: every foreground/background pair passes WCAG 2.2 AA and remains legible under the indoor 25% screen-dimming model.
Rounded hero figures (SF Pro Rounded / Nunito) paired with clean tabular system numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) across GBP (£) and INR (₹).
Strict material boundary: Liquid Glass carries floating controls on iOS/iPadOS only, never content cards and never Web PWA chrome.
Layout-stable Privacy Mode (••••) that redacts every currency balance, chart callout, scrub tooltip, and accessible aria-label in place.

rules.name: The Quiet Drawdown Rule
rules.body: Green (positive with ▲) is reserved for gains, while routine daily market dips use quiet secondary ink (ink-secondary with ▼); crimson (alert) appears only on genuine red-tier alerts and destructive actions.

rules.name: The 25% Brightness Rule
rules.body: Every colour token lives in the top-level :root, .t-light and .t-dark blocks of tokens.css (and .mp / .t-dark .mp in ios.css) and must stay legible both at 100% and at 25% indoor screen luminance. The contrast_check.py gate that measured this on the boards was stopped by MA-303 (Arun, 2 Nov 2026); the rule is now measured on the built web app by MA-304, QA on request; iOS QA comes after MA-165, with no story yet.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: .mp sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums globally so every currency figure, delta, percentage, share count, and scrub readout aligns without horizontal jitter.

rules.name: The No-Clip Reflow Rule
rules.body: Flex and grid cells never rely on text-overflow: ellipsis for financial figures; below narrow container thresholds (374px, 359px, 699px), key-value pairs and table columns wrap or scroll horizontally inside their card.

rules.name: The Content-Off-Glass Rule
rules.body: Content (the navy hero, ledger cards, grouped rows, charts, and chat messages) is never glass, glass never sits on glass, and the Web PWA never renders iOS Liquid Glass (.lg) or .sheet-grab handles. Labels on iOS glass use ink or ink-secondary, never ink-tertiary.

dos: Do route every displayed currency value, chart aria-label, and scrub tooltip through Privacy Mode masking (privacy-mask / •••• / aria-label="Hidden") when Privacy is active.
Do put aria-hidden="true" on every decorative .ms Material Symbols ligature span and provide explicit aria-label attributes on icon-only controls.

Do keep all colour tokens inside the top-level :root, .t-light and .t-dark blocks (mirrored identically in @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) for unforced roots) and sync ds-v1/{tokens.css,ios.css,motion.css,motion.js} byte-for-byte to ios-v1/ and app-v1/ by hand (no gate measures the copies since MA-303).
Do support keyboard :focus-visible, Escape dismissal on modals/sheets, and pointerup / ArrowLeft / ArrowRight on interactive [data-scrub] charts.
donts: Don't leak iOS Liquid Glass (.lg), .sheet-grab handles, or fake 44px iPhone notch padding onto Web PWA screens.
Don't write unscoped a:hover rules on boards that override .mp-btn-primary text colour, or reference undefined CSS variables (--mp-uk, --mp-in).
Don't clip 100% plan benchmark ticks inside overflow: hidden tracks — use .has-tick with an inner .mp-track-clip / .bar-clip fill wrapper.
Don't draw stroked chart paths inside <defs> referenced via <use> on preserveAspectRatio="none" SVGs, or introduce multi-field CRUD creation forms outside the chat.
